items.title: Drone debris reportedly falls on Ukrainian Foreign Ministry grounds in Kyiv
items.summary: Reports from Kyiv say debris from intercepted drones fell on the grounds of Ukraine's Foreign Ministry during an aerial attack. Footage also reportedly showed Russian drones changing direction sharply while flying over the capital; no injuries or damage at the ministry were specified.

items.title: Canada announces additional ammunition and equipment support for Ukraine
items.summary: A report says Canada is committing another C$45 million to the Czech ammunition procurement initiative for Ukraine, alongside approximately C$55.8 million for WESCAM sensor systems and C$20.9 million for winter equipment. It also says Ottawa plans to transfer up to 1.6 million rounds of 20mm ammunition from Canadian stocks.
